bank3_stage_before_publish.boot_bootstrap: A distinct pre-family L65O record stages and destination-verifies the Boot family before the independently installed Workbench record and before c2_product_prepare_boot may publish it.
bank3_stage_before_publish.bootstrap_chain: The resident loader authenticates exactly one fixed record: the pre-family Boot stager. That authenticated cold record parses and source-verifies the fixed Workbench successor in unpublished Bank-2 scratch. A sized Non-LTO assembler commit seam, reached by a tail jump that preserves the original loader return address, copies only the already verified successor into the self-overwriting Bank-0 VMA, rechecks destination CRC, executes it and wipes it. Fixed successor VMA, entry and length live in one six-byte resident immutable table, so neither overlay owns a relocation to its NOCROSSREFS sibling. No generic resident record parser or second C commit implementation exists.
bank3_stage_before_publish.bootstrap_scratch: Bank 2 is unpublished scratch only between pre-family Record 1 verification and the later C2-lite Bank-2 stage. No Bank-2 handle or READY state exists at this point; destination verification precedes the Workbench commit and the ordinary Bank-2 stage replaces the scratch before publication.
bank3_stage_before_publish.failure: An absent, zero, stale or mismatching tuple, an unstaged family, a corrupt destination, wrong generation or timeout returns VM_RUNTIME_OVERLAY_ERR_FAMILY_STAGE before publication.
bank3_stage_before_publish.generation_rule: c2_ready invalidates Bank-2 reachability at restage; the Bank-3 family latch is overwritten with a non-callable STAGING state before the first replacement byte. VERIFIED is non-callable until select_family publishes the exact family/generation.
bank3_stage_before_publish.identity: Final pack size and CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE for each complete family are published after the sole link in the eight-byte non-LTO suffix.
bank3_stage_before_publish.placement: Boot stager in its own pre-family L65O record; Session stager in its own final Boot-family slice after phase 03. Invalidation, copy, verification and failure handling live in those cold bodies; resident state is limited to family/generation and the publish gate.
bank3_stage_before_publish.session_transition: A distinct final Boot-family slice after phase 03 invalidates the Boot generation before overwriting Bank 3, then copies Region 1 from the disjoint 0x08300000 tenant into the now-vacant Bank-5 shelf scratch and destination-verifies both regions before select_family publishes Session.
